title: Google aims for influencers with the Pixel 11 Creator Suite
summary: The new phones are getting a bundle of features designed to help burgeoning influencers film and edit content. The partnership touted how Google’s ecosystem would help Cooper’s business as a content creator — scripting videos, shooting content, and keeping her team organized.
